text: なまえは　なんて　いったかな？

structure.jp: なんて　いったかな？
structure.en: what did he say, I wonder?

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな is a casual 'I wonder', often said to oneself. いったかな = 'did (he) say... I wonder'.

patterns.name: 〜て (quoting)
patterns.explanation: なんて is a casual 'what' used before saying/quoting. なんて　いった = 'what did (he) say'.
